_README: DATA-NINJA-SHAPE-WATCH (F-140 layer 1): the poe.ninja key names AshLight's parsers READ, per route family, for server/al/ninjashape.py. Key names only: no price, no item name, no league name. A path is dot separated; a list on the path (lines, items, core.items, or the leagues list itself) is checked element by element, and the share is the part of its elements that carry a usable value at the rest of the path. A key in `read` on under half of the elements is a break; a key also in `soft` is recorded but only reports a change (the item family until a real item body confirms it, research 0036). Hot reloaded (decision 0042): a bad edit keeps the last good baseline and shows a Checks note.
